ideas.pitch: An offline-first environmental and infrastructural impact auditor for local municipal bodies running on lightweight on-device models.
ideas.title: ImpactLens Local
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the 'Build for Impact' theme by targeting hyper-local civic issues with a tangible solution that can be deployed instantly during the offline judging day.

ideas.pitch: A workflow orchestrator for university administrative processes that models requests using BPMN and uses human-in-the-loop AI agents to flag bottlenecks.
ideas.title: CampusFlow BPMN
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rigorous workflow automation and enterprise architecture, which appeals strongly to judges looking for scalable, real-world utility over simple wrapper apps.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic routing system matching local farmers' produce queries directly to regional agricultural schemes and mandi prices without expensive API roundtrips.
ideas.title: AgriRoute Semantic Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a genuine regional socioeconomic problem with sophisticated routing algorithms, matching the high technical bar of previous semantic router winners.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight GitOps and container deployment dashboard designed for rural computer labs to manage offline-first educational software updates seamlessly.
ideas.title: EduSync Cloud Bridge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses educational inequality in rural regions by providing robust infrastructure management tools that are easy for judges to evaluate during a live offline demo.

ideas.pitch: An offline-capable clinical data indexing and retrieval tool designed for frontline health workers operating in low-connectivity rural zones.
ideas.title: MediAssist Field Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-impact healthcare utility with clever local vector database caching, securing strong marks in both social impact and technical execution.
